title: Menagerie
description: Resident characters you pick, drawn and voiced for you, in the Chat view. Turn on, then set up your cast.

settings.label: Generation model
settings.description: Writes and draws each character (one run per character or reroll; spends tokens).

settings.label: Characters to start with
settings.description: Comma-separated names, generated (as "play them") only at the plugin's first start, if the cast is empty then; spends tokens. Asked on the first-run page.
settings.placeholder: Ron Burgundy, a grumpy lighthouse keeper

firstRunOffer.label: Menagerie: resident characters in your sessions
firstRunOffer.description: Name a few characters you like; each gets a voice, lines, a cartoon portrait and animations, and hosts some of your sessions. Generating them spends tokens (one Opus run each).

ask.label: Characters you like (comma-separated, up to six)
ask.placeholder: Ron Burgundy, a grumpy lighthouse keeper
